name: mutoscope
description: Turn code changes, systems and ideas into interactive, discussable animated reels. A model-agnostic agent skill + CLI, portable reel format and static player.

scripts.build: npm run build:player && npm run build:cli
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:examples && npm run test:e2e
scripts.validate:examples: for d in examples/*/; do node skills/mutoscope/runtime/cli.mjs validate "$d" || exit 1; done
